_comment: Datasheet-derived design rules keyed by a regex matched against the symbol value / lib id. Capacitor ranges are in nF, distances are pad-to-pad on the PCB in mm.

parts.name: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1
notes: 3V3 needs 100 nF + 10 uF close to pin 2 (Espressif hardware design guidelines).
EN needs an RC delay: 10k pull-up to 3V3 and 1 uF to GND.
GPIO19/GPIO20 are the native USB D-/D+ pair.
Keep copper and components out of the antenna keep-out at the module's top edge.

parts.name: STM32 (generic)
notes: One 100 nF per VDD pin plus one 4.7 uF bulk capacitor per device (AN2586 / AN4488).

parts.name: BME280
notes: CSB high selects I2C; SDO selects address 0x76 (GND) / 0x77 (VDDIO).

parts.name: DRV8833
notes: VCP needs 10 nF to VM. nFAULT is open-drain and needs a pull-up.

parts.name: AMS1117
notes: AMS1117 needs >= 22 uF (tantalum/ceramic with ESR) on the output for stability.
